parameters.T_planning_horizon_minutes: <int> Total length of the planning horizon over which all train services must be scheduled.
parameters.D_num_train_services: <int> Number of train services to be dispatched during the planning horizon.
parameters.NT_num_demand_periods: <int> Number of equal-length demand periods that partition the planning horizon.
parameters.h_min_minutes: <int> Minimum allowed time gap between two consecutive interior train departures.
parameters.h_max_minutes: <int> Maximum allowed time gap between two consecutive interior train departures.
parameters.C_train_capacity_passengers: <int> Maximum number of passengers that can board a single train at departure.
parameters.demand_profile_type: <str> Label describing the shape of the passenger arrival pattern across demand periods.
parameters.total_demand_passengers: <int> Total number of passengers arriving over the entire planning horizon.

demand_periods: <list[dict], length NT_num_demand_periods> Passenger arrival rates for each demand period, each entry containing 'period' and 'lambda_pax_per_min'.
feasibility_lower_bound_AWT_minutes: <float> Theoretical lower bound on average waiting time per passenger, derived from the minimum headway.
